# Pricing Page Teardown

`pricing-page-teardown` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · Strategy & Positioning
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/pricing-page-teardown/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Where does our pricing page lose buyers, and can a live price test answer our question in the time we have?

**Inputs:** Yes, partly, no or not-sure answers to the 21 checks for your pricing page and up to three competitors; for a price test, the current and test price per conversion, today's conversion, your honest guess at the test price, weekly pricing-page visitors and the weeks you could run it; afterwards each arm's visitors, conversions, revenue and the planned size

**Output:** Each page's weighted score by area with the top five fixes on yours and how many competitors already pass each; the break-even conversion, visitors and weeks a live test needs, the smallest change your traffic could detect, and a testable or not-testable call with alternatives; and a read-out against the planned size with a p-value, a not-randomised caveat where it applies, and a 90-day retention check

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill pricing-page-teardown`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/pricing-page-teardown/resources/pricing-teardown.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/pricing-page-teardown/resources/pricing-teardown.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- A page's score is a share of points on the checks answered, so unanswered checks drop out: a page with two of 21 checks answered scored 100%. Answer all 21.
- The 21 checks and weights are AAJ's judgement applied to your yes, partly or no answers. They are not a benchmark and cannot see real buyer behaviour.
- The honesty checks point at US rules (ROSCA, California auto-renewal, FTC pricing guides). They do not replace legal review and do not cover rules outside the US.
- The test plan rests on your guess at conversion at the new price. Before-after and sales-quote reads are not randomised and give direction only.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns the pricing page answers every check from the live page; finance confirms both prices are on the same basis and conversion comes from a month of analytics; legal checks the honesty and terms items.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/pricing-page-teardown](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/pricing-page-teardown)
